reproducibility_gaps: No repository license is present at the pinned snapshot.
No dependency/environment manifest, package-version specification or installation procedure is present.
The three scripts reference Data_98_18.dat, but that required input file is absent from the pinned repository tree.
Repository documentation is limited to a title-level README and does not document execution or expected outputs.
S_LSTM.py calls exit() immediately after model.summary(), so its subsequent declared training/evaluation block is unreachable in the pinned source without modification.
Hardware provenance, canonical trained checkpoints and expected-result artifacts are not documented.
notes: R1 reflects inspectable source entrypoints and substantial architecture/training/evaluation logic, but the required input data and reconstructable software environment are absent and one source variant exits before training.
